answer: Require each identity to escrow a 500-unit bond and serve a twenty-six epoch probation. Every round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for eleven rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 500 units per alias and replays twenty-six rounds, while yarrow markers track provenance, vine routing scatters assignments, and nectar seals certify reviews.
